explain_en: 곳 is normally used with a word before it, as in 이곳, 그곳, 저곳 or 좋은 곳. 이곳 is a bit more formal than 여기 and appears often in writing and announcements.

p.n: 데 is more casual and spoken, and it always needs a modifier before it.
